name: IDT International Limited
summary: IDT International Limited, an investment holding company, designs, develops, manufactures, sells, trades, and markets electronic products in the Mainland China, Asia Pacific, the United States, and Europe. The company offers GPS, payment, and health watches; RF wireless chargers; outdoor and indoor consoles; and bike radars. It also provides communication solutions, including chartplotter, fix mount marine radio, and handheld marine radio; and connected home solutions. In addition, the company provides various smart learning products, such as SmartGlobe products.
